# third_party

Vendored third-party code, one directory per upstream, each generated by
`tools/licence-audit.py --copy-to`. The rule and the audits behind it are in
`docs/THIRD-PARTY.md`.

Only permissively licensed files are copied here, and they are copied
verbatim: the copyright header and the SPDX line are what makes the reuse
lawful, so they are never edited or stripped. Each directory contains:

| file | what it says |
|---|---|
| the sources | the vendored files, with their relative paths preserved |
| `MANIFEST.tsv` | path, licence, category, size and sha256 of every copied file |
| `EXCLUDED.tsv` | what was left behind and why |
| `NOTICE` | upstream URL, commit and the date of the copy |

Nothing here is edited by hand. If a vendored file needs a change, the change
goes into our own tree as a patch applied at build time, or the upstream is
re-copied and the diff is committed on its own.
